flavor: A vast, subterranean hollow where the walls are lined with thousands of unglazed clay vessels. In the center, a massive, pulsating mound of silt and jagged quartz rises from the floor, emitting a low, rhythmic hum that vibrates through the soles of your boots.
name: The Terracotta Reliquary
reason: The party encounters a primordial earth-bound creature bound within the central silt-mound, offering ancient geological secrets in exchange for offerings of precious gems or blood.
